0.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_000
0.description: Lookin' to dirty yer hands in this here ring, are we? I like yer spirit, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, but there's rules to be followed, a certain protocol what serves to maintain order when fists are flyin' an' blades are slashin'. If ye have any questions, I suggest ye speak up.

1.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_005
1.description: Ye can come here to the arena an' clout yer mates any time ye please, so long as ye stick to the rules.

2.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_006
2.description: I'll pound 'em into that skull o' yers if I have to, and that's assumin' yer opponents don't bash yer head in first. Either way, sufferin' builds character, I always say.

5.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_A1_000_002
5.description: Are there any restrictions when fighting here?

6.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_A1_000_003
6.description: How can I challenge others to a duel?

7.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_A1_000_004
7.description: What does it take to win?

8.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_A1_000_005
8.description: What are the rules of engagement?

10.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_010
10.description: This here arena was built so pups like yerself can sharpen yer claws without havin' to climb down into the Pit.

11.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_011
11.description: 'Course it won't do ye any good to stand around fightin' yer shadow. Ye'll need a mate what'll agree to crossin' blades. Whether yer warmin' up for yer next big bout or practicin' some fancy new technique, yer not like to find a better spot.

12.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_012
12.description: When standing within the dueling arena, you may challenge another player to a duel. Please note that both you and your desired opponent must meet certain requirements to participate.

13.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_013
13.description: Furthermore, be aware that certain actions are restricted when fighting within the dueling arena.

14.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_020
14.description: The arena's for practice, but we still expect ye to give it yer all. That said, we've put a few checks in place to prevent things from gettin' out o' hand.

15.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_021
15.description: Class or equipment changes are not permitted inside the arena. Furthermore, materia melding requests and trade requests are also prohibited.

16.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_022
16.description: It is not necessary to leave your party to participate in a duel. However, combat actions such as attacks and healing cannot be used on party members who are engaged in a duel with another player.

17.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_030
17.description: What do ye mean <hex:021A020203>how<hex:021A020103>? Just go and bloody ask someone to fight. So long as they've earned the right to fight here in the den, and they agree to yer terms, that's all ye need.

18.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_031
18.description: To challenge another player to a duel, both you and your desired opponent must be inside the dueling arena. Once inside, target them and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Request a Duel<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the subcommand menu.

19.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_100_031
19.description: When requesting a duel, you will also have the option to sync item levels.

20.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_032
20.description: When receiving a duel request from another player, accept the request within the allotted time, and the battle will commence.

21.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_033
21.description: Should you choose to decline, or in the event that the allotted time expires, the duel will be called off.

22.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_034
22.description: It is also possible to duel players currently in your party. However, you cannot challenge a player to duel if they have a pending challenge or if they are currently engaged in a duel with another player.

23.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_040
23.description: Sharp eyes and a sure hand... I suppose them fancy relics ye adventurers are always diggin' up couldn't hurt either. Just know that once the fightin' starts, ye can expect to keep goin' till someone keels over.

24.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_041
24.description: The duel will end when either you or your opponent is incapacitated. In the event a player steps outside the arena while their duel is in progress, the player remaining in the arena will be declared the winner.

25.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_042
25.description: Using the Duty Finder or Raid Finder to enter an instance will also result in the forfeiture of any duel in progress.

26.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_DUELOFFICER_000_050
26.description: Duels here are a test o' strength, a match o' skills to see who's got bite an' who's naught but bark. Simple as that. If yer feelin' adventurous, as ye adventurers are wont to be, I'd suggest seekin' out opponents tougher than yerself. Just don't be surprised if I put me gil on the other guy.

27.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPDUELGUIDE_00368_SYSTEM_000_051
27.description: Materia and morale bonuses will not be applied during duels. Any beneficial effects activated prior to starting a duel, however, will remain in effect.
